messages.author: 16a5e15a39b75879
messages.subject: non-default installation?
parts:
Hi,

If I don't have root access on my system, how can I put
aroma.affymetrix in my local R library location?

Usually I use install.packages(c("module1", "module2"), lib="/path/to/
my/R/libs")

but hbInstall("aroma.affymetrix", lib="/path/to/my/R/libs") doesn't
work...

I'd appreciate your advice.

Regards,

Jean

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] non-default installation?
parts:
Hi,

I've updated hbInstall() [and hbLite()] to also take the 'lib'
argument. However...

...instead of having to specify the 'lib' argument each time you
install R packages, there is a much more convenient way to do this.
Set the environment variable R_LIBS (or R_LIBS_USER), cf.
help(libPaths). You can set this in the OS settings and/or in your
~/.Renviron file, cf. help(Startup). These options are cross
platform. If you have more question on the latter, please use the
r-help mailing list.

Hope this helps

Henrik
